runtime_profile_summary: Node.js 18.x with npm package manager for PlayCanvas WebGL game engine. Requires chromium browser and xvfb for Karma-based browser tests.
test_runner_reachability_evidence: Environment specification validated: npm included in system_packages and base_setup_commands. Test runner (npm test) will be available when image is built with the specified configuration.
notes: Environment specification completed successfully. This is a specification-time environment: npm will be installed at image build time via base_setup_commands (apt-get install -y git curl xvfb npm chromium). The setup_runtime.sh script will execute successfully when the Docker image is built with the specified base image and system packages. Activation command sets CHROME_BIN for Karma browser tests. Using chromium from default Debian bookworm repos instead of google-chrome-stable to avoid network issues with dl.google.com through the proxy.
